_comment: Cards for tests/unit/keywords/test_granted_persist.py. `t_gp_sergeant` is Dusk Legion Sergeant's '{1}{B}, Sacrifice this creature: Each nontoken Vampire creature you control gains persist until end of turn.' without its menace: the grant is the `grant_ability` op handing over a grantable persist trigger, the same `dies` trigger with a `counters_had` condition a printed persist creature carries. `t_gp_vampire` is a plain nontoken Vampire for it to reach.

cards.name: Test Granted Persist Sergeant
cards.oracle_text: {1}{B}, Sacrifice this creature: Each nontoken Vampire creature you control gains persist until end of turn. (When it dies, if it had no -1/-1 counters on it, return it to the battlefield under its owner's control with a -1/-1 counter on it.)

abilities.text: {1}{B}, Sacrifice this creature: Each nontoken Vampire creature you control gains persist until end of turn.
